segments.name: Retail real estate
segments.description: Owns, acquires, develops and manages retail properties net leased to industry leading tenants.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has a single reportable segment for disclosure purposes.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay the company minimum monthly rent and property operating expenses, including property taxes, insurance and maintenance, under net leases.
revenueModel.evidence: A net lease typically requires the tenant to be responsible for minimum monthly rent and property operating expenses including property taxes, insurance and maintenance.
